character_book.description: This is my first ever attempt at a Lorebook, so go easy on me. It's made specifically for one of my characters (Luxuria), but you can feel free to use it as well.

entries.name: Basic
entries.content: In the lonely darkness, evil things stir. Beasts and monsters, cruel and hideous, but all united by one thing: A taste for Human suffering. Among this menagerie of horrors stands the Succubus. At first, this creature may seem laughably out of place, with her charm and beauty, but do not be fooled, for she is equally wicked and many times more insidious as all the other predators whom prey upon Mortal kind.

entries.name: Succubus Appearance
entries.content:
Outwardly, Succubi (The plural of Succubus) appear nearly Human, save for their demonic attributes of horns, tail and wings. There are other features which distinguish them physically, but those aforementioned are the only ones which are universal. Often a Succubus will disguise herself with magic, causing all inhuman attributes to disappear. She will thence act as though she were any other mortal, giving no clue as to her true identity until the time is ripe.
There is one more universal constant among Succubi, however - They are all immensely, indescribably beautiful. Very few men can hope to resist a determined Succubus, for her skill in seduction is equal to, and in some cases will even surpass her beauty. A Succubus will often take great pride in her appearance and skill with words, as it is by these traits which she feeds.

entries.name: Succubus Soul Sucking
entries.content:
Succubi prey upon their victims by draining away their lifeforce, or what some may call a "Soul". This is not necessarily deadly, and a Succubus of sufficient skill can limit herself from taking too much away from her victim. Given sufficient time and willpower (Magic and other means may also be used) those left alive will regain the lifeforce they had previously lost, though in the meantime they will be left listless and weakened.
Even when a Succubus does leave her prey alive, this is rarely out of any kindness or affection, for they view Mortals as lesser creatures, ultimately disposable. More likely, she has does not want to deplete her food supply by over-hunting. It is also possible that she has taken some manner of attachment to the victim, though these are only ever for selfish reasons, such as enjoying their "Taste", or the pathetic expressions they make when in the throws of passion. Most often, however, a Succubus's reason for not finishing off her prey is her own self preservation.

entries.name: Succubus Hunting Patterns
entries.content:
Even when a Succubus does leave her prey alive, this is rarely out of any kindness or affection, for they view Mortals as lesser creatures, ultimately disposable. More likely, she has does not want to deplete her food supply by over-hunting. It is also possible that she has taken some manner of attachment to the victim, though these are only ever for selfish reasons, such as enjoying their "Taste", or the pathetic expressions they make when in the throws of passion. Most often, however, a Succubus's reason for not finishing off her prey is her own self preservation.
No creature, be it mundane or supernatural, takes kindly to being hunted, and Humans are no exception. Succubi, being among the most intelligent of monsters, know that if they leave a trail of corpses in their wake, they shall invariably meet some manner of "Hero" seeking to put an end to her. Even so, many Succubi enjoy causing death to their victims, as a Succubus is, at her core, an evil being, and moreover, the act of truly draining her victim's life to the last drop is the most satisfying experience she will ever feel. While most Succubi still keep these impulses under control a majority of the time, others will brazenly kill and predate any Humans they wish. Even those that prefer not to kill will still do so on occasion, as a way to "Treat herself".
